Thanks for reporting an issue with ArchitectureCraft — GTNH Shapes.

Please include:

- The jar filename and SHA256 (for example `architecturecraft-1.12-3.108-gtnh-shapes.jar`,
  `64DCC0C1...`).
- Minecraft, Forge and Cleanroom versions.
- The full `latest.log` or crash report, uploaded to Gist or Pastebin. Do not paste the whole
  log into the issue.
- Steps to reproduce, and whether the issue also happens with the upstream
  `architecturecraft-1.12-3.108.jar`.
- For rendering issues: a screenshot and whether cladding was applied.

Please do not say “latest”; name the exact jar and versions.
